_: Every repository, file, quotation, commit and pull request that the paper cites as evidence.

repos gives, for each repository, the commit at which the paper reads it. verification/check_sources.js checks that each commit is on the repository's main, that each cited file exists at that commit, that each quotation occurs in the file (after the normalisation described in that script), that each commit exists, and that each pull request was merged into main.
The paper prints a quotation only through \srcq{id}, so the printed words are generated from this file (scripts/generate.js writes paper/evidence.tex).
